title: OFM active work order
description: Payload of {enterprise}/{site}/{area}/{line}/workorder: the work order currently active on the line, derived from work-order events (ADR-0010). Published retained on every work-order event.

active.description: True while an order is running on the line.

ts.description: Time of the work-order event that produced this message.

sku.description: Product code as text, so leading zeros are kept.

ratePerHour.description: Rated speed in units per hour valid at ts for this product on this line (ADR-0010).

startedTs.description: Time the order was started (start of the changeover window).

changeover.description: True while the changeover window is open (ADR-0010 point 4).
